finalText:
**Found it — every failing cart has a percent coupon on it.**

`engine.js` rounds the running USD total to cents twice on the way through, at lines 24 and 27. That throws away a fraction of a cent *before* the exchange rate multiplies it up.

The tests treat one rounding, at the very end, in the target currency, as the contract.

Whether that lost sliver tips the final cent depends on the rate, so most carts still land right. `GBP`, `CAD` and `JPY` are the ones that show it.

The fix is to drop both mid-way `round(..., 2)` calls and keep only the one on line 31. I checked that version against all 40 cases and it matches.

Right now: 30 pass, 10 fail, 93ms. I haven't changed any code yet — say the word.
